jobs.description: Job Description: Sr Dir, Enterprise AI Adoption & Transformation Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers. This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career. The Impact You Will Make in this Role 3M is accelerating the adoption of generative AI and agentic technologies to transform how employees access knowledge, make decisions, automate work, and create business value. The Senior Director, Enterprise AI Adoption and Transformation will lead enterprise-wide adoption of Amazon Quick and related generative AI capabilities across 3M. This role serves as a senior product leader, enterprise evangelist, and transformation catalyst for AI adoption. The successful candidate will partner across business functions, technology, data, cybersecurity, legal, privacy, and executive leadership to identify high-value use cases, move solutions from pilot to production, establish repeatable adoption patterns, and deliver measurable business outcomes. This is a business-led technology transformation role, not primarily an infrastructure or cloud engineering position. The ideal candidate combines strong knowledge of generative AI and agentic technologies with enterprise product management, organizational change leadership, executive communication, and value realization discipline. Primary Responsibilities Develop and execute the enterprise adoption strategy for generative AI capabilities across the company. Serve as the enterprise product leader for the AI employee experience, including roadmap, use case prioritization, adoption strategy, and value delivery. Partner with leaders across R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Human Resources, Global Business Services, and other functions to identify and prioritize high-impact AI opportunities. Translate business challenges into scalable AI products, workflows, agents, knowledge experiences, and automation solutions. Align to a structured process for AI use case intake, prioritization, incubation, governance, scaling, and ongoing adoption. Lead executive demonstrations, business workshops, roadshows, innovation sessions, and AI showcases to build awareness and demand. Build and activate a community of AI champions and power users across 3M. Collaborate with AI platform engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data, cloud, privacy, and compliance teams to enable secure and scalable solutions. Support integration of AI capabilities with enterprise systems and data sources. Influence the enterprise AI platform roadmap based on business needs, adoption barriers, user feedback, and value opportunities. Define success measures and executive reporting for adoption, active usage, productivity improvement, cycle time reduction, employee experience, risk, and financial impact. Partner with business leaders to validate realized benefits and continuously prioritize investments toward the highest-value use cases. Leadership Attributes Passionate advocate for practical, business-focused enterprise AI. Technically credible while remaining highly focused on business outcomes and user adoption. Able to simplify complex technologies for executives, business leaders, and employees. Strong product mindset with focus on user experience, scalability, and measurable impact. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping strategy in a rapidly evolving technology area. Pragmatic, curious, and willing to challenge traditional ways of working. Able to move quickly from idea to experimentation to scaled deployment. Commercially minded and focused on value realization, not technology deployment alone. Your Skills and Expertise To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in technology field (completed and verified prior to start) Twelve (12) years of experience in technology, digital transformation, product management, enterprise innovation, or related fields in a private, public, government or military environment Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: Significant experience in technology, digital transformation, product management, enterprise innovation Experience leading enterprise-scale technology, AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, digital workplace, or transformation initiatives. Experience deploying technology platforms or digital capabilities across large, complex organizations. Experience working with senior executives and cross-functional business leaders. Demonstrated experience moving AI or digital solutions from concept and pilot through production deployment and scaled enterprise adoption. Strong understanding of generative AI concepts, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, AI agents, enterprise search, knowledge management, model evaluation, context management, and prompt engineering. Experience with AWS AI technologies, including Amazon Quick, Amazon Q, Amazon Bedrock, or related AWS services. Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Glean, Google Gemini, Salesforce Agentforce, or ServiceNow AI. Strong understanding of enterprise applications and data environments, including SAP, Microsoft 365, ServiceNow, Salesforce, cloud data platforms, APIs, and structured and unstructured enterprise information. Knowledge of cybersecurity, identity and access management, information governance, privacy, responsible AI, and enterprise risk controls. Proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority. Strong executive communication, storytelling, facilitation, and presentation skills. Demonstrated ability to build coalitions across business, technology, data, cybersecurity, and corporate functions. Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.
We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As a User Researcher on the Economy team, reporting directly to the Director of Design Strategy & Operations, you will generate actionable qualitative and quantitative insights that shape core economic systems, developer monetization workflows, and immersive brand experiences. Embedded directly on product teams, you will conduct generative and evaluative research centered on how creators build businesses, how brands interact on the platform, and how users participate in virtual economies. You will tackle high-priority features, solve complex behavioral puzzles, and help translate multi-faceted economic infrastructure into intuitive, trustworthy, and scalable experiences. Partnering closely with Product, Product Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Policy, you will ensure user needs directly inform platform decisions while driving mutual value across players, creators, and brands.
You will:
Execute end-to-end mixed-methods research projects to understand creator monetization, payouts, advertising, and commerce workflows, translating abstract user behaviors into clear product feature recommendations.
Conduct foundational research to uncover key user pain points, mental models, and behaviors across creators, players, and brands to guide long-term UX strategy.
Work with cross-functional stakeholders in Design, Product, Policy, Legal, Engineering, and Data Science to facilitate research discussions and give concise feedback to inform feature roadmaps and product vision.
Partner with Analytics and Data Science to combine qualitative insights with behavioral platform data, building a holistic view of user engagement and economic health.
Work in close collaboration with cross-functional teams to evolve research processes and foster a culture of inclusion, collaboration, and innovation.
Have opportunities to present your research findings and strategic implications clearly to Product Group leadership.
You have:
4+ years of professional career experience as a UX or product researcher.
A Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in HCI, psychology, marketing research, sociology, anthropology, or other social science field with an emphasis on research, or equivalent work experience.
Knowledge about a variety of research methods. Is comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative methodology and can identify the correct methodology for the question at hand. Preferably has experience using software vendors like Qualtrics, database analysis with SQL and can conduct statistical analyses in SPSS, R or Python.
Engaged in collaboration and sharing work frequently, inviting feedback from peers and manager or supervisor
Solutions and a tuned thought process that ensure research will adequately answer questions and even challenge if the questions being asked are the right ones.
The ability to articulate and research findings clearly through verbal, written, and visual communication

jobs.description: At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us reinvent how a global organization buys the goods and services that power its operations, this is your chance to make history. We are seeking a Category Manager to own and strategically source goods and services globally across Worldwide Operations (WWOps) on behalf of the Global Procurement Organization (GPO). This role sets category strategy, leads cross-functional sourcing teams, negotiates with suppliers, and partners with our most senior stakeholders to advance the full set of GPO strategic imperatives: delivering savings, mitigating risk, and improving productivity, while also expanding managed spend coverage, creating value across the supply chain, driving commercial excellence and compliance, unlocking supplier innovation, and pursuing optimization and standardization at scale. This role will be expected to modernize the procurement process itself, using AI and automation to make sourcing faster, smarter, and more scalable. Key job responsibilities Category strategy & sourcing * Establish global category sourcing strategies; lead cross-functional strategic sourcing teams, negotiate with suppliers, and execute contracts to optimize Amazon's competitive position across WWOps. * Provide guidance on the development, execution, and management of category sourcing strategies for purchases across the enterprise. Identify, achieve, and report on savings and value targets for all category sourcing activities. Stakeholder & supplier management * Collaborate with business teams and procurement functional areas, including supplier diversity, finance, legal, and procurement operations, as the global category procurement expert. * Partner with businesses and key stakeholders to optimize supplier relationships for innovation, value realization, continuous improvement, and risk mitigation. * Lead the negotiation and implementation of supplier agreements/contracts, working with cross-functional stakeholders and suppliers to reach agreement on terms and conditions. * Align with internal customers and deeply understand the business application of the portfolio. Market intelligence & influence * Act as a market intelligence provider for the category; anticipate strategic opportunities and keep key stakeholders informed on market shifts, licensing model changes, and emerging suppliers. * Help develop long-term department strategies and significantly influence cross-company project development, delivery processes, and standards. Driving efficiency through AI & automation * Reimagine the procurement process end-to-end using AI, identifying high-friction, manual, or repetitive steps (intake, supplier research, contract review, renewal tracking, spend analysis) and deploying AI/automation to eliminate them. * Use AI-driven tools to accelerate market and supplier intelligence, benchmark pricing, surface consolidation and rationalization opportunities, and flag renewal and compliance risk earlier. * Build repeatable, data-driven playbooks and standardized workflows that scale across WWOps with less manual effort. * Partner with internal tech, finance, and procurement operations teams to pilot and adopt AI capabilities, measure their impact, and champion adoption across the broader GPO organization. * Establish metrics that quantify efficiency gains (cycle-time reduction, hours saved, coverage expanded) and report on them as a core deliverable of the role. A day in the life A Category Manager in GPO owns a global category across WWOps, blending strategy, negotiation, and process reinvention into each day. Mornings start with data: reviewing refreshed spend, renewal timelines, compliance flags, and savings tracking (rolling up to the Pan Amazon Spend Reduction goal), often with AI-generated summaries surfacing price changes and consolidation opportunities. The core work spans preparing for and leading complex supplier negotiations, running cross-functional sourcing teams with finance, legal, and procurement operations, and partnering with senior stakeholders to steer buying decisions toward organizational value rather than duplicate spend. A defining thread is working on the process, not just in it: piloting AI workflows to automate manual steps like intake triage, measuring the efficiency gains, and championing adoption across the broader GPO team. The day closes by updating savings and value tracking, quantifying automation impact, and aligning senior stakeholders against the full set of GPO strategic imperatives, before scanning ahead for the next negotiation milestone and the next step worth automating. About the team The GPO Tech Category Team is Amazon's strategic technology procurement organization within the Global Procurement Organization, responsible for sourcing the technology goods and services that power Worldwide Operations. Applying rigorous category management, the team takes end-to-end ownership of its spend domains, from demand planning and sourcing strategy through negotiation, award, contract management, and supplier relationship management. Its work is anchored in creating value across the supply chain, delivering commercial excellence and compliance, and driving optimization and standardization at scale, while partnering closely with senior stakeholders across the business to align sourcing decisions with organizational priorities and the full set of GPO strategic imperatives.

jobs.description: Amazon's Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) organization builds frontier models and the AI agents on top of them, and every one of them depends on data we can trust. The Frontier AI (FAI) Assessment team owns the science of dataset quality — for the data that trains frontier models, and for the benchmarks that determine whether a model or an agent actually works. In this role you will build the automated systems that make quality assessment at scale. Large language model (LLM)-as-a-Judge is the starting point, and our goal is to develop an agentic system that plan its own audits, critiques its own judgments, and improves its own accuracy over time. You will design it, calibrate it against expert human judgment, and set the technical direction for how the organization measures data quality. Key job responsibilities - Design the assessment methodology for frontier AI assets - Build the automated assessment system, from LLM-as-a-Judge baselines to agents that plan their own audits and learn from their own errors - Oversee the expert audit program and raise the proficiency of the auditors who run it - Design the measurement methods that make quality findings defensible, including sampling strategy and error analysis - Communicate findings to the teams that create the data and to the teams that train models and build agents using it - Set technical direction for assessment science, mentor junior scientists, and present results to senior leadership - Publish research on assessment methodology at top-tier venues and contribute to patents A day in the life - Train AI agents to assess the quality of datasets and evaluation benchmarks, and document where they fall short - Diagnose their failures and improve the models, rubrics, and calibration behind them - Review the quality reports that auditors and agents produce, and decide whether the conclusions hold - Coach expert auditors and junior scientists, and move more of the manual audit work into automation - Lead research on self-improving assessment agents, from open problem to publication About the team FAI Assessment is part of Frontier AI Assets in AGI. We assess the quality of the datasets and benchmarks behind Amazon's frontier models and agents, and we define what good data means. Today that work relies on human-in-the-loop review by domain experts. Our aim is to automate it with self-improving agents that experts keep calibrated. We are a small team of scientists working closely with the data, modeling, and agent teams.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic’s Safeguards Enforcement team detects and mitigates misuse of Claude, and much of that work depends on people: a growing human review workforce made up of full-time staff, contractors, vendors and BPO partners. As that workforce scales across a widening range of harm areas, the programs that bring people in, give them the right access, and roll them off cleanly have to keep pace.
As Program Manager for Safeguards Workforce Operations, you’ll own those programs end to end. You’ll run onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning and access provisioning for every worker type we use, working hands-on with the requests themselves while you build the processes that make them repeatable. You’ll partner with Enforcement leads to turn shifting priorities into capacity plans, and carry those plans through with our vendor partners. Because this role supports every Safeguards Enforcement program, you’ll also connect the dots across Anthropic, working with IT, People Operations, Security, Contingent Workforce, Human Data Operations and other teams running scaled human review to streamline practices and keep standards consistent.
This is a role for someone who likes fixing broken things at speed. The landscape moves quickly, priorities change often, and the work is an even mix of direct execution and program building.
Key responsibilities
Own the workforce lifecycle for contractor, vendor and BPO reviewers: onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning and access provisioning
Triage and execute inbound requests for new or changing vendor, BPO and contractor capacity
Turn ad hoc or broken processes into scalable ones, with clear owners, service levels and a system of record
Partner with IT and Security on access governance: least-privilege provisioning, timely revocation and regular access reviews
Build and maintain capacity plans with Enforcement leads, translating review demand into workforce needs and adjusting as priorities shift
Work with Safeguards vendor management to hold partners accountable to capacity and onboarding commitments
Align practices with Human Data Operations and other teams running scaled human review, and help them streamline their own workflows
Help define the long-term workforce strategy for Safeguards Enforcement
Minimum qualifications
Have personally run onboarding, offboarding, access and device provisioning for contractor, vendor or BPO workforces — doing the work, not only overseeing it
Have operated scaled human review programs with vendors or BPOs, such as trust & safety, content moderation or data annotation operations
Have taken a broken or ad hoc process, made it scalable, and brought other teams along in adopting it
Understand the fundamentals of capacity planning: how volume, handle time, quality targets, ramp and attrition turn into workforce needs
Exercise sound judgment on access and permissions, and know when to bring in IT or Security
Move quickly and stay effective when priorities change and information is incomplete
Build alignment through direct partnership with the teams you depend on
Preferred qualifications
Owned a vendor or BPO relationship directly, including service levels and business reviews
Built formal capacity models for review or operations workforces
Supported workforces across more than one enforcement or harm area
Hands-on experience with device management and identity and access tooling
Worked through a period of hypergrowth where programs had to mature alongside the organization

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!

jobs.description: What if you could redefine how millions of people communicate at work? At Amazon, email isn't a utility. It's infrastructure. It's trust. It's the invisible thread connecting every team, every decision, and every customer interaction across one of the most complex organizations on earth. The Amazon Enterprise Engineering team owns that infrastructure. We operate Amazon's Tier 1, AWS-based email platform at a scale few engineers ever encounter, delivering billions of messages and neutralizing billions of threats every single year. But our sights are set far beyond what exists today. We are building the future of enterprise communication, and AI is our catalyst. Partnering directly with AWS product teams, we are reimagining what email can be: smarter, faster, more secure, and fundamentally more human. This is not incremental improvement. This is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to reshape how the world's largest teams work together. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager based in Arlington, Virginia, who can turn ambiguity into action and vision into shipped product. In this role, you will be the driving force behind some of Amazon's most consequential infrastructure programs, aligning engineering teams across organizational boundaries, accelerating delivery on initiatives that touch every Amazonian, and partnering with AWS product leaders to bring next-generation capabilities to life. Your work won't live in a roadmap. It will live in the tools millions of people rely on every single day. If you believe the best version of enterprise communication hasn't been built yet, and you want to be the one who builds it, we want to hear from you. Key job responsibilities As a Technical Program Manager on the Amazon Enterprise Engineering team, you will be at the center of Amazon's most critical infrastructure programs, driving delivery and making things happen at scale. jobs.description: Craft: Job Description: Principal Game Designer ( Puzzle Core) Help craft the moment to moment magic of a new King Game Join our New Games Studio and help build the next generation of King experiences. We’re developing a new casual puzzle game and we’re looking for a Principal Game Designer to help shape the feel, challenge, and moment to moment fun of the game. In this role, you will design and evolve the core puzzle gameplay, including level mechanics, blockers, moment to moment interaction systems , and overall difficulty progression that define the player experience. Working closely project Leadership, you will help craft gameplay that is deeply satisfying, approachable, and scalable across thousands of levels, ensuring that the game delivers both delightful player experiences and strong long term engagement. Your Role Within Our Kingdom As a Principal Game Designer, you will play a key role in defining and refining the core gameplay systems of the game , helping ensure the puzzle experience remains engaging, readable, and satisfying for players across the entire progression journey. You will work closely with other designers, artists, engineers, and product partners to bring gameplay features to life and ensure they align with both the creative vision and the broader game strategy. You will: Design and iterate on the core puzzle gameplay, ensuring the moment-to-moment interaction feels satisfying, responsive, and accessible. Create and evolve blockers and level mechanics, developing gameplay elements that introduce challenge, variety, and strategic depth. Help define the overall gameplay feel, including pacing, readability, clarity, and player feedback. Collaborate with design leadership team to ensure blockers and mechanics integrate well into the wider level progression. Partner with Product Managers and Data Scientists to analyse player behaviour and tune gameplay difficulty, progression, and engagement. Prototype and develop new gameplay mechanics, exploring ideas that enhance the puzzle experience and expand the game’s design space. Ensure gameplay systems align with the game’s broader meta and economy systems, working with systems and economy designers when necessary. Maintain high standards of design quality, balancing creative ambition with technical constraints and production realities. Document and clearly communicate gameplay designs, ensuring teams across disciplines understand design goals and player outcomes. Identify and communicate design risks early, working closely with producers and engineers to ensure smooth delivery. Stay connected to the market, analysing puzzle and casual games to identify emerging trends and opportunities. Contribute to the studio’s design craft community, sharing learnings and supporting the growth of fellow designers. Skills to Create Thrills Experience working on mobile games, particularly free to play titles. Strong passion for casual mobile games and meta game design. Proven experience designing meta systems, progression frameworks, or long term engagement mechanics in successful games. Strong understanding of player motivation, progression design, and long term engagement loops. Experience designing systems that connect gameplay with progression, rewards, and feature unlocks. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret player behaviour and data insights to guide iteration. Experience collaborating within multidisciplinary teams, balancing creative, technical, and product perspectives. Strong organisational skills with the ability to drive features from concept through delivery. Clear and effective communicator verbally, visually, and in written documentation. Comfortable working in fast-moving development environments where systems evolve through iteration. Experience working on Sorting / Match Pair / Match 3D mechanics is especially valuable. Game Experience We’re looking for someone with a strong background in creating video games and a passion for designing compelling casual meta experiences. Mobile development comes with unique opportunities and constraints, requiring a balance of creativity, insight, and technical awareness. We want someone who embraces those challenges with enthusiasm and a desire to craft experiences that will delight millions of players around the world. We’re Seriously Playful Officially, we’re a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world. Unofficially, we’re a serious business that takes pride in having fun. Every day at King, we blend intuition with analysis, art with science, and imagination with execution to craft games the world loves to play. Our mission is simple: bring moments of magic to everyday life. If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you. A great saga needs all sorts of heroes Making games is fun. Especially when you do it with people who share the same idea of what makes a good workplace great. We design games for everyone, no matter where they are or who they are, and we employ all sorts of people from all kinds of backgrounds to bring them to life. Truth is, we simply can’t expect diversity in our players and originality in our games without first nurturing it in our people. A great saga needs all sorts of heroes. About King With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.
